run_inpaint_image: run KandinskyV22InpaintPipeline to inpaint a masked region of an image using image embeddings
prepare_mask_and_masked_image: prepare a mask and masked image tensor pair for the Kandinsky inpainting pipeline
prepare_mask: prepare and clean mask tensors by removing isolated pixels for Kandinsky inpainting
downscale_height_and_width: downscale height and width dimensions to be divisible by the scale factor squared
prepare_latents: prepare random or provided latent tensors scaled by the scheduler init noise sigma
